name: Thabit Translator
overview: Fetch, extract and translate subtitles using the ThabitTranslator library.
description: Adds a "Thabit Translator" subtitle provider to Jellyfin's per-item download menu plus a scheduled task that sweeps libraries and fills in missing subtitles. The heavy lifting (subtitle download providers, embedded-track extraction, Argos translation, Vosk speech-to-text) is done by the bundled ThabitTranslator Python library, which runs inside the container image.

versions.changelog: Initial release - subtitle provider, library sweep scheduled task, configuration page and status API.
